notes: Win/lose conditions and the clear-flag chain for the vertical slice. Clear flags are set when a room's enemies are all defeated (per rooms.json locked_by). Expected pacing: ~10-15 minutes end to end for a first-time player.

win_condition.notes: The crown_fragment spawns in dungeon_05 only after the boss_guardian is dead (rooms.json items condition boss_defeated). Picking it up transitions the game to the Victory state.

lose_condition.notes: hp_max reached 0 (hp <= 0) transitions the game to the GameOver state. hp_max is 6 per player.json.

clear_flags.notes: Informational only — dungeon_01 is open from the start (locked_by null).
First real gate: slimes must fall before the chain advances.
Boss route gate: per design this single flag unlocks BOTH dungeon_04 and dungeon_05. The temple_key item from dungeon_03 is separately required for the boss arena door inside dungeon_05.
No downstream gate — dungeon_05 already opened on dungeon_03_cleared. Flag kept for telemetry/telemetry-style room-clear stats.
Spawns the collectable crown_fragment; collecting it sets the Victory state.

required_sequence: clear dungeon_03, collect temple_key, set dungeon_03_cleared (unlocks dungeon_04 and dungeon_05)
use temple_key on boss arena door, defeat boss_guardian (phase 2 at 50% hp spawns 1 slime once)
notes_balance: Enemy counts: 11 slimes + 8 skeletons + 1 boss (+1 phase-2 slime) across 6 rooms. Slime = 2 sword swings, skeleton = 4, boss = 15. Three heart pickups plus the starting 6 hp cushion the 1-2 damage hits. Tuned for a ~10-15 minute first clear.
